_readme: Owner: Set C. One place for every real-world number. The HUD shows these and the physics uses the same gravity. Set "verified": true and fill "source" with the NASA page only after you have checked the number yourself. Checked on 14 Nov 2026 against the NASA planetary fact sheets (nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov).
